name: K. J. Yesudas
description: One of India's most acclaimed playback singers, renowned for his extensive contribution to Malayalam cinema and music.
contribution: A defining voice of Malayalam film music whose career spans several decades and multiple Indian languages.

name: K. S. Chithra
description: Celebrated playback singer known for her expressive voice and extensive body of work in Malayalam and other Indian languages.
contribution: A major female voice in Indian playback singing, with a particularly significant contribution to Malayalam cinema.

name: P. Jayachandran
description: Veteran Malayalam playback singer admired for his distinctive voice and emotional interpretation of film songs.
contribution: Contributed generations of memorable songs to Malayalam cinema and became one of Kerala's most respected playback voices.

name: M. G. Sreekumar
description: Popular Malayalam playback singer and music director known for energetic, melodic and devotional songs.
contribution: A prominent voice in Malayalam film music with a long career as a singer and composer.

name: Sujatha Mohan
description: Acclaimed playback singer known for her melodious voice and extensive contribution to South Indian film music.
contribution: Became one of the best-known female playback voices associated with Malayalam cinema from the late twentieth century onward.

name: Vijay Yesudas
description: Malayalam playback singer and actor who has built a prominent career across South Indian film music.
contribution: Established an identity of his own in playback singing while continuing the musical legacy associated with the Yesudas family.

name: Shahabaz Aman
description: Malayalam singer, composer and musician recognised for his distinctive approach to film and independent music.
contribution: Brought a contemporary and soulful musical voice to Malayalam cinema and independent music.

name: Sithara Krishnakumar
description: Versatile Malayalam singer and musician known for film songs, independent music and live performances.
contribution: Known for combining classical training with contemporary styles across Malayalam film and independent music.

name: Vineeth Sreenivasan
description: Malayalam singer, filmmaker and actor who became widely recognised through film music before expanding into filmmaking.
contribution: A prominent modern Malayalam film personality whose work connects playback singing, acting, writing and direction.

name: Shreya Ghoshal
description: One of India's leading playback singers, with an extensive repertoire of Malayalam film songs alongside work in several Indian languages.
contribution: A major contemporary playback voice whose Malayalam songs have become popular across generations.

name: Haricharan
description: South Indian playback singer known for his work in Malayalam, Tamil and other Indian-language film music.
contribution: A widely featured contemporary voice in Malayalam film music and South Indian playback singing.

name: Najim Arshad
description: Malayalam playback singer and composer known for his work in contemporary Malayalam cinema.
contribution: Developed a recognised presence in Malayalam film music through playback singing and composition.

name: G. Venugopal
description: Veteran Malayalam playback singer known for his expressive voice and enduring contribution to film music.
contribution: One of the familiar voices of Malayalam cinema, with a long career spanning numerous film songs.

name: Madhu Balakrishnan
description: Malayalam playback singer known for film songs, devotional music and work across South Indian languages.
contribution: Built a substantial career in playback and devotional singing, particularly in Malayalam music.

name: Rimi Tomy
description: Popular Malayalam singer and television personality known for energetic performances and film songs.
contribution: Became a familiar contemporary voice in Malayalam entertainment through singing and television appearances.

name: Jyotsna Radhakrishnan
description: Malayalam playback singer known for her work in contemporary South Indian film music.
contribution: A recognised female playback voice in Malayalam cinema, particularly across the 2000s and later.

name: Manjari
description: Malayalam playback singer known for her distinctive voice and work in film and independent music.
contribution: Established a strong presence in Malayalam film music with melodic and expressive performances.

name: Karthik
description: Indian playback singer and composer with a significant body of work in Malayalam and other South Indian languages.
contribution: A prolific contemporary playback voice heard across major South Indian film industries, including Malayalam cinema.

name: Prithviraj Sukumaran
description: Malayalam actor, filmmaker and producer who has also contributed as a playback singer to selected films.
contribution: Represents the multi-talented Malayalam film personality who has combined acting, filmmaking, production and singing.

name: Dulquer Salmaan
description: Malayalam actor and producer who has also performed playback vocals in Malayalam and other Indian-language films.
contribution: Added playback singing to a wider career spanning acting and film production across multiple Indian languages.

name: Mohanlal
description: Legendary Malayalam actor and filmmaker who has also performed playback singing in several films.
contribution: A multi-disciplinary Malayalam cinema figure whose contributions extend beyond acting into singing, production and direction.
